description: This file defines the EmployeeAllowedLanguageModel class which is part of the OrangeHRM system. It represents a model for employee language preferences, serializes data related to allowed language fluencies, and interacts with services and entities to assemble the data. It is used for API responses or internal data handling related to employee language permissions.

classes.name: EmployeeAllowedLanguageModel
classes.description: A model class representing allowed languages for an employee, capable of serializing language data with fluency restrictions.

methods.name: getEmployeeLanguageService
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns an instance of EmployeeLanguageService.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Converts the model data into an array suitable for API responses, fetching and processing employee language data to determine allowed fluency IDs.
